concerns: docs/plans-page.md already states the component's central US-3 guarantee verbatim -- 'The component reads no settings and imposes no sign-in requirement, so it can be placed on any page of your own project, whether or not this package's Account Center pages are in use.' Adding the db fixture (D6 in decisions.md) made it pass immediately, with no change to pricing_table.html. The component's self-sufficiency claim held on first real attempt, exactly as the brief's WATCH note anticipated -- recorded honestly rather than smoothed into a conventional red/green story.
